user.title: Add Art-Net / DMX node
user.description: Set up a DMX gateway. You'll add its lights afterwards from the integration page.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the node. Not needed for the Art-Net controller.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the protocol default (6454 Art-Net, 5568 sACN, 6038 KiNET).
data_description.host_override: Actual address packets are sent to, if different from Host (Host stays the identity of the node).
data_description.refresh_every: Seconds between resending values when no fade is running. 0 disables.
data_description.send_partial_universe: Disable if your controller only accepts full 512-channel frames.
